## Product/DX review checkpoint

The implementation has now been normalized around the actual contributor journey rather than a one-off config command.

### Corrected logic

The previous version returned early when the global identity was valid, which meant a malformed repository-local value such as `pc@ai.(none)` could still override it and keep commits broken. The helper now cleans malformed local overrides first, then preserves or resolves the global identity.

### Verification completed

`Codespaces Git identity` passed:

- POSIX shell syntax validation;
- valid-global + malformed-local override cleanup;
- authenticated GitHub profile resolution;
- Codespaces login fallback;
- non-blocking unresolved-identity behavior.

Rebuild a Codespace from branch `chore/codespace-git-identity`, then run:

```sh
git config --global --get user.name
git config --global --get user.email
git config --local --get user.email || true
git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT
git var GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT
```

Expected result: a valid global identity, no malformed local override, and both Git author/committer variables resolving without error.
